caption: Trani Cathedral, Trani
composition: Pale Romanesque cathedral and campanile on the Adriatic · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the paved seafront terrace, the camera takes in Trani Cathedral's pale stone bulk against a partly cloudy 07:45 morning sky. The tall slender campanile rises at center-right above the long Romanesque nave, its arched portal facing the water, while the Adriatic stretches left toward the distant town rooftops and harbor masts. Stone bollards line the terrace edge at the lower right, and soft daylight plays across the pale limestone facades.
